title: Act: Show the 'Sending…' loading label on the Send button
summary: Switch the Send button label based on the submitting state.
description: Render 'Sending…' as the button label while submitting is true, otherwise 'Send'. Uses the submitting state added for the disabled computation.
acceptance_criteria: Button text is 'Sending…' while submitting is true.
Button text is 'Send' whenever submitting is false.
technical_constraints: Requires the submitting state from the disabled-state unit to exist in the file

steps.action: Change the button child text from the literal 'Send' to a conditional on submitting, and expose busy state with aria-busy.
steps.expected: While the request is pending the button reads 'Sending…'; afterwards 'Send'.
